facts.en: visitors from China in 2024, +78% vs 367,000 in 2023. Mutual visa-free regime since November 2023: up to 30 days per visit, max 90 days in 180 days.
facts.zh: 2024年来自中国的游客，较2023年的36.7万增长78%。自2023年11月起互免签证：每次停留最多30天，每180天累计不超过90天。
facts.source: The Times of Central Asia, citing the Ministry of Tourism and Sports

facts.en: Chinese citizens visited in 2025, +38.9%. China is the #2 source market after Russia (429,800).
facts.zh: 2025年到访的中国公民，增长38.9%。中国是仅次于俄罗斯（42.98万）的第二大客源国。

facts.en: foreign visitors for tourism purposes in the first nine months of 2025, excluding labour migrants and permanent residents.
facts.zh: 2025年前九个月以旅游为目的的外国访客人次（不含劳务移民和常住人员）。

methodNote.en: The two China figures use different methods (border crossings vs analyst data) and must not be compared directly.
methodNote.zh: 两组中国游客数据统计口径不同（边境入境人次 vs 分析机构数据），不可直接比较。

policies.label: Proposal
policies.note: Team proposals for the real service. Not yet in force.
policies.booking: Booking in 3 steps: trip, lead traveler, payment. Booking date at least 7 days ahead. 1-12 travelers.
policies.payment: International cards (Visa, Mastercard etc.) through a payment provider's hosted checkout; the company never sees card numbers. Alipay and WeChat Pay are planned after provider approval. Prices are in KZT; USD/CNY amounts are indicative only. The prototype is in TEST MODE: no money moves.

refund.en: Your money is held until the tour starts.
refund.zh: 您的款项在行程开始前由第三方托管。
出发前14天以上：全额退款
出发前不足4天：不予退款

refund.en: Free reschedule for road closure or severe weather
refund.zh: 因道路封闭或恶劣天气可免费改期

policies.trust: Before paying, a traveler can watch a guide intro video and request a 5-minute video call with the guide.
policies.familySharing: Optional family updates share trip status (not live GPS), off by default, stop after the trip.
policies.referral: Postcard with a referral link; a first-booking discount for the friend is a proposal.
